about: #4628: each surviving det-port mutant stated `equivalent` or `unreachable`, with the Java change and why it cannot alter observable behaviour; proposed in a PR, reviewed by the owner. A run that kills a stated mutant fails (the claim was wrong). Ids are mutation.py's; before / after are the Java line.

verdicts.equivalent: the change cannot alter anything the program shows (output, screen, files, COMMAREA, abend)
verdicts.unreachable: no input of the program reaches the changed code
verdicts.harness-gap: the change alters behaviour the proof runs but does not compare (open: the harness must)
verdicts.case-gap: an input the case lacks would kill it (open: strengthen the case)

survivors.reason: WS-COMMAREA's VALUE image: 0000-MAIN's INITIALIZE WS-COMMAREA moves 2000 spaces over it before anything reads it
COCRDSLC never reads CUSTOMER-RECORD (it COPYs CVCUS01Y but names none of its fields), so its initial image cannot show

IMAGE of DFHCOMMAREA (a later chunk): COCRDSLC reads DFHCOMMAREA only as DFHCOMMAREA(1:160) and (161:12), which in_ writes from the caller's COMMAREA first; this byte of the 32767-byte image lies past them, and for a terminal task the area's final contents are not observable (CICS discards them; linked_result drops them)

survivors.reason: in_CarddemoCommarea copies a DTO field into DFHCOMMAREA, which COSGN00C never references (only EIBCALEN); the bytes only go back through fill_ into the task's COMMAREA object, not observable for a terminal task (linked_result drops it), and the DTO fields are never null (the case INITIALIZEs the whole record), so the null guard is not taken either. This case is not linked, so no link-area bytes mask the DTO path, but the program has no reader of it.

survivors.reason: the raw-area copy runs only when task.linkArea() is set, i.e. a det-port program LINKed COTRN02C with its COMMAREA's bytes; no CardDemo program LINKs COTRN02C (a terminal transaction entered by XCTL)

Cutting s_DFHCOMMAREA to EIBCALEN bytes (X23) matters only to a reference past EIBCALEN; COSGN00C never references DFHCOMMAREA, and the plumbing's own in_ (runs before the cut) and fill_ (runs after caWhole restores the full array) see the whole array either way, so cutting or not cutting is unobservable for every EIBCALEN.

the restore of the TRUNC mode in runTask's finally matters only to code that runs after the task in the same JVM; every det-port entry point sets the mode itself (runTask: swapTruncBinary(true)) before it runs a program, and the harness code between tasks reads no COMP field.
